projectDescription: A production-ready UI component library built on shadcn/ui for building Pokédex applications, providing composable React components for Pokémon data display.
keyFeatures: Composable Pokémon-specific React components built on shadcn/ui and Radix UI primitives
PokemonImage component with size variants (sm, md, lg, xl) and fallback support
Semantic type badges for all 18+ Pokémon types with consistent styling
Normalized stat bars and radar chart visualizations for Pokémon stat data
Evolution chain components supporting branching paths and conditions
Headless-first design — bring your own data source (PokéAPI, custom backend, static JSON)
Full TypeScript support with proper type inference
Accessible components with semantic HTML and keyboard navigation
shadcn registry integration for easy CLI installation
publicApiSurface: PokemonImage — avatar-based image container with size variants
PokemonSprite — image element with object-contain and transition
PokemonFallback — fallback state with optional error styling
PokemonBadge — type badge with semantic color variants
PokemonStat / PokemonStatRoot / PokemonStatLabel / PokemonStatBar — stat display components
PokemonChart — radar/bar chart for stat distribution
EvolutionRoot / EvolutionContent / EvolutionNode / EvolutionGroup / EvolutionBranch / EvolutionTrigger — evolution chain primitives
PokemonCard — card component for Pokémon overview display
